title: 2.3L EcoBoost Emission Control: System and Component References
introduction:
This reference applies to Engine Emission Control - 2.3L EcoBoost (231kW/314PS). I start with the system explanation, then read about its components; learning names is much more useful when you know what job those parts belong to.

Both subjects require the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual at the location below. This page provides the signpost, with no emission-control operating details, component descriptions, diagnostic tests or repair steps.

edits.text: For an explanation of emission control system operation, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual. See Section 1 Description and Operation.
edits.why: The operating explanation provides the context needed to understand the system’s components.

edits.text: For descriptions of the emission control components, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual. See Section 1 Description and Operation.
edits.why: Use this companion reading to understand the individual parts alongside the whole-system explanation.
